facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition held a validation workshop on 17 June 2026 on the draft national AI roadmap 2026-2030, after drafting it with the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and the diaspora and collecting contributions from national actors and the diaspora; participants were asked for recommendations (Sidwaya, which also gives 18 June once).
